pulls.title: bass_cr: return PHYS02D pulse grid identity first failure
pulls.body:

This additive return preserves actual exit 1, wall 103.797892739 s, raw stderr/stdout, reservations, runtime/resources, independent HOLD review and the bounded amendment request. Legacy never started; CDF, moments and ramp residuals are unavailable. All seven inherited gates remain unchanged. Wrapper exit 0 records completed failure collection, not numerical success.

Validation: exact science/publication ancestry retained; 359 original bundle payloads and 259 dependencies verified; final return ZIP exact entry set/CRC/all 397 payload identities verified and restored into a new layout, including 87 unit-manifest entries and 74 preparation-review bindings. Actual runtime Python 3.12.3, NumPy 2.4.2, SciPy 1.17.0, numerical threads 1. No old ramp suite or extra G/pulse calls.

Final immutable ZIP: 5,350,251 bytes, SHA256 `2400e9a4350d03379b12fdad00c8990c93099011dfc95530b02ae2c26e8dc4c5`. [Drive archive](https://drive.google.com/file/d/18RE6v7GmGE33x1uQaFsLcvEac7Jcnd6E/view), Dropbox `id:BSpOijBcT10AAAAAAD3-1Q`, rev `65d85bb5eb64b0af03d47`. Full detached metadata receipts are included in `research/cr_phys02d_ncp_return_20261011/DELIVERY_RECEIPT.json`.

pulls.title: CR-PHYS02D: heat-delay moments and same-grid pulse handoff
pulls.body:
## 연구 질문

기존 paired 9,600점 ramp 계산은 완료됐지만, 순간 열률비가 어떤 지연 통계인지와 pulse 누적분율을 구분할 필요가 있었습니다. 이 PR은 저장된 결과에서 유한창 지연 모멘트를 도출하고, 남은 frozen-operator 정보를 측정할 다음 pulse 작업을 준비합니다.

## 변경과 결과

- 양의 고정 커널에서 R=E[X], S=E[X²], X=(1−τ/T)+를 유도합니다. 현재 가열의 원천 나이는 T−2Q/P, clipped mean은 T(1−R)입니다.
- 기존 legacy/fullBED의 2,400·4,800·9,600점 JSON을 한 번 분석합니다. 여섯 selected 행과 18개 birth-tag 행, SI/Decimal 교차검사, CDF 경계를 보존합니다.
- fullBED 9,600점 현재 평균 원천 나이: **97.419429 yr**. Pulse의 F(T/2) exact-model 경계: **1.316618–5.520554%**. F(T) 하계: **4.936104%**. Uncapped mean은 endpoint 두 값만으로 식별되지 않습니다.
- 같은 9,600점에서 fullBED 다음 legacy의 pulse 코드·active resolvent·엄격한 실행/반환 manifest를 준비합니다. 최대 새 G 2회, pulse 2회, 전체 3600 s입니다.

## 검증과 실패 기록

직접 유도, 정확한 Fraction 측도와 Decimal90 oracle, endpoint targeted tests, 작은 one-pole/직렬cascade/Erlang-2 및 운영 fixture를 사용했습니다. 초기 CSV export, sparse shape, propagated cutoff assertion, collector manifest 실패는 원본 그대로 남고 제한된 수정만 수행했습니다. 수치 입력·물리식·허용값은 바뀌지 않았습니다.

이번 준비에서 실제 물리 G/수송/과거 suite 재실행은 **0/0/0**입니다. NCP pulse의 실제 물리 실행은 **PREPARED_NOT_EXECUTED**이며, 실행 결과에는 새 독립 판정이 필요합니다. 후보 설계·구현과 독립된 Astra review 및 정확한 reviewed_files는 연구 단위 review/에 있습니다.

## 계보와 범위

Base: PR #31, f98ed974c3f3158dabd16cd854ecc5e04b9f5b31. 신규 변경은 research/cr_phys02d_20261011/에 한정됩니다. 원래 PR30의 실제 반환과 실패/adapter를 재사용하며, eecb9bd 후기영수증 sibling 계보는 구분합니다.

4,800→9,600점 비교에는 Python/NumPy 변화도 포함되므로 순수 격자 오차 인증으로 읽지 않습니다. PHYS02_DELAY OPEN, production_history HOLD, atomic_G02 UNRESOLVED, b_grid NO_GO, all_bound OPEN, R17B2B NO_CERTIFIED_SOURCE_SHARPENING, CCC SOURCE_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED를 유지합니다.

## 전달

REPORT_KO.md, START_NCP_CODEX_KO.md, ncp/README_KO.md를 시작점으로 사용합니다. 완전 ZIP과 standalone NCP start를 기존 Drive/Dropbox에 새 파일로 게시했고, 실제 영수증과 한 번의 clean restore/plan 결과를 receipt-only commit에 추가했습니다. main merge와 force push는 수행하지 않습니다.

## 실제 게시 identity와 복원 확인

- Science commit: `6ed83ff61aff24fe51ff0370736f70e0e52893f8` (신규 science/preparation 88 files)
- Receipt-only head: `a2486869dba5c2d43257c13e33a31b66752d5e10` (신규 publication 13 files, 원본 science 88 files 및 immutable ZIP unchanged)

- Start: `CR_PHYS02D_20261011_6ed83ff6_NCP_START_KO.md`, **17801 bytes**, SHA256 `da066f54a1c5e8b630c8f87bbae607954161affb95f79b0b2fb1ad15ce492197`
- [Drive NCP start](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EE11a-gepxjyDELoo8syXZj2k9WY3Lxo/view?usp=drivesdk); Dropbox `/BASS_DERIVATION_DOSSIERS_20260912/CR_PHYS02D_20261011_6ed83ff6_NCP_START_KO.md`, ID `id:BSpOijBcT10AAAAAAD36kw`, rev `65d84714cb8b90af03d47`.

related_hh.title: R31AO: authority-compliant unequal order ladder
related_hh.body:
## Scope
Additive research/preflight design on R31AN. No science node or new order computation is executed.

## Main change
The blocked equal-ratio B144-B192-B256 ladder is replaced by a source-authority-compliant B128-B160-B192 ladder already covered by the recovered frozen source contract:
- OD unchanged guard allows n<=192.
- JVP frozen grids exist for 128,160,192.
- exact-weight source declares intended frozen B96--B192 range.
- B256 remains outside unchanged OD authority.
- B144 lacks the frozen JVP grid.

No producer/source modification is proposed.

## Unequal-ratio analysis
Under the conditional scalar/fixed-error-direction model Q_n=Q_inf+C n^-p,

rho=d128160/d160192
=((5/4)^p-1)/(1-(5/6)^p).

Wolfram verifies this function is strictly increasing for p>0, with lower endpoint
log(5/4)/log(6/5)=1.2239010857415446...

Thus:
- rho <= threshold: positive-p power model incompatible normwise.
- rho > threshold: unique positive p exists.

Conditional formulas:
E192=d160192/((6/5)^p-1)
E160=d160192/(1-(5/6)^p).

These are always conditional asymptotic diagnostics, not rigorous source bounds. Matrix spectral-norm increments additionally require stable error direction.

## Future bounded preflight
NCP should:
1. reverify grid/source authority,
2. inventory any existing z=0.75 B128/B160 complete OD+JVP outputs,
3. prelock raw unequal-order comparator and direction diagnostics,
4. prelock finite-order primary+secondary verdict replay across B128/B160/B192,
5. if B128/B160 outputs are missing and authority is closed, create a one-shot scope for exactly those two new orders,
6. execute zero science commands in the preflight.

B192 existing z=0.75 output is reused.

## Claim ceiling
SOURCE_ACCURACY_BOUND_UNAVAILABLE and rigorous-reference certification remain open even if the finite-order ladder is clean. No interval enclosure, special-function bound, roundoff certificate, or assembly bound is created here.

Fresh helper tests: 6 PASS. No merge requested.
